name: Caleb Smith I

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Martha, daughter of William Henry Smith of the 'Tangier' family; children Paul Theodore, Caleb 2d, Martha.

bioAdditions: Pelletreau (S1) describes him as 'a sturdy patriot' who refused the oath of allegiance to the King during the British occupation, though many kinsmen signed it.

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 476-477, 491
sources.supports: Caleb Smith dates, marriage, children; refusal of the oath
